assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a standalone photorealistic full-body front-view character reference for an AI video production character library.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing character sheet, the source of the complete outfit and body proportions. Image 2 is the same fictional adult woman's portrait, the primary identity/face anchor. Preserve exactly this woman, Lin Mu, a fictional adult age 28; do not redesign her or substitute a new face.
Primary request: make ONE newly composed standalone full-body frontal studio photograph of this same woman on a clean pure white seamless background, portrait aspect ratio 3:4. The crown of her hair through the complete soles of both white shoes must be visible with modest clear margin above and below. She stands naturally facing the camera, weight evenly balanced, both arms and hands relaxed at her sides, calm neutral-friendly expression, looking straight at camera.
Invariants: preserve her facial features, apparent adult age, natural skin texture, shoulder-length dark side-parted hair tucked behind one ear, body proportions, ivory/off-white long-sleeve linen button-front shirt with a single chest pocket and gently rolled cuffs, sand-beige straight-leg trousers, and plain white low-top sneakers exactly as in the references. Do not change the shirt cut, colors, trousers, or shoes. Keep the styling simple and identical.
Lighting: soft even neutral studio light, realistic fabric weave and gentle contact shadow immediately beneath her feet; otherwise a clean white background, not warm gray.
Composition: one person centered, single continuous photograph, eye-level straight-on view, full body, no cropping, no panels, no collage, no character sheet, no repeated figures, no labels, no text, no watermark, no additional objects. Use a fresh high-quality rendering, not a crop or enlarged panel from the source sheet.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a photorealistic facial-expression reference sheet for the fictional adult female character Lin Mu.
Input image: the single attached portrait is the identity, hairstyle, skin-tone and wardrobe reference. Preserve this same adult woman, age 28, in every panel.
Primary request: generate one NEW square image containing exactly NINE head-and-shoulders portraits, arranged in a strict 3 columns by 3 rows grid with nine equal square cells and thin even white gutters.
Expressions, left to right and top to bottom:
1. Neutral, relaxed lips and brows.
2. Gentle closed-mouth smile.
3. Natural open-mouth laughter, smiling eyes.
4. Surprised, raised eyebrows and slightly open mouth.
5. Thoughtful, contemplative gaze and subtly pursed lips.
6. Concerned, softly knitted inner brows.
7. Slightly angry, firm mouth and restrained tense brows.
8. Sad, lowered mouth corners and sorrowful eyes.
9. Confident, direct gaze and a small assured smile.
Each expression must be visibly distinct yet natural. All nine portraits are front-facing at the same eye-level camera angle, the same head scale and position. Every cell must include her ENTIRE hair crown with a clear white margin above, her whole head, neck and upper shoulders. Do not cut off hair or head.
Invariants: preserve the reference face shape and facial features, adult age, natural skin texture and tone, shoulder-length dark side-parted hair tucked behind one ear, and ivory/off-white linen button-up shirt. Do not redesign her, change her age, change clothes, add jewelry, or substitute other people.
Background and lighting: clean pure WHITE studio backdrop in all cells; consistent soft neutral studio light, realistic skin and fabric.
Constraints: exactly 3 rows and 3 columns, exactly nine portraits of the same woman, no extra portraits, no cropped heads, no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no logos, no props or hands covering the face. This is a newly rendered expression sheet, not a repeated copy or crop of the input portrait. Square output, ideally 1536 by 1536.
